libraries.sanitize-html: the recovery-sequence preview discards tags outside a five-tag email allowlist; Prelum's ./render/safe only scans and refuses
libraries.jose: test only: test/admin-access.test.ts signs Access tokens to drive the real verifier
libraries.mdast-util-directive: types only: app/lib/blog/markdown.server.ts imports its mdast type augmentation for directive nodes; the parsing itself is Prelum's ./render

copies.app/lib/blog/format.ts: generateSlug makes the blog's heading ids, which must stay legacy Recova's so links to a section made before the move still land; Prelum's slugify hyphenates where it drops punctuation (stripe-s-fees, not stripes-fees). Post slugs and media names use slugify
copies.public/_headers: not by hand: the build's site-runtime-headers writes it from Foxhound's registry entry, the set buildSecurityHeaders({ site: foxhound }) gives the Worker; committed so the /assets/* cache rule can be read

tokens.--surface: Foxhound keeps Recova's amber look on its own domain (Dustin 2026-10-25/26); its public tokens are Recova's
